metadata.name: fct_invoice
metadata.comment: Incremental fact table for invoice-level measures and event dates. One row per invoice. Descriptive invoice attributes are in dim_invoice. Loaded via merge on invoice_sk.

invoice_sk.name: invoice_sk
invoice_sk.comment: Surrogate key. Foreign key to dim_invoice.

amount_due.name: amount_due
amount_due.comment: Invoice amount due, excluding GST. In AUD.

created_dt.name: created_dt
created_dt.comment: Date the invoice was created in Tracker. UTC.

issue_dt.name: issue_dt
issue_dt.comment: Date the invoice was issued. UTC.

paid_dt.name: paid_dt
paid_dt.comment: Date payment was received. Null if unpaid. UTC.

proc_created_at.name: proc_created_at
proc_created_at.comment: Timestamp this row was first written to the data warehouse.

load_run_id.name: load_run_id
load_run_id.comment: dbt invocation ID for the pipeline run that created this row.

load_run_at.name: load_run_at
load_run_at.comment: Timestamp of the pipeline run that created this row.

max_varchar.description: Size of the largest column that uses a VARCHAR data type.
